{{Otheruses|Imperial Edict}}
{{Quote|The Princess re-programmed the PA system to play the Anthem of the Republic (in direct violation of Imperial Edict 2.33b) during assembly.|Madam [[Nestor]]|<ref name="TFU2">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
'''Imperial Edict 2.33b''' was a law created by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It forbade playing the anthem of the defunct [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TFU2" /> entitled ''[[All Stars Burn as One]]''.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|23|All Stars Burn As One}}</ref> In [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]], a seven-year-old [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] tampered with the PA system during an assembly at the [[Crevasse City Collegium for Young Ladies|Collegium for Young Ladies]] in [[Crevasse City (Alderaan)/Legends|Crevasse City]], re-programming the device to play the forbidden anthem.<ref name="TFU2" />
